# Teenage you

- Drop your photo here named **photo.jpeg**. It appears automatically.
- Edit **secret.txt** for the little note hidden behind this photo.
- Replace the text in **message.txt** with your message for this chapter. Use plain text, without quotes or code.
- For PNG/WebP or a different filename, update this chapter's image path in ../../content.js. Renaming the extension does not convert an image.
- Adjust the title, caption, photo description (alt), and little handwritten note in ../../content.js.

The current JPEG is connected to this chapter.
